newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares extend fall at close on rate, Dow concern.
newsitem.headline: KL shares extend fall at close on rate, Dow concern.

text.p: Malaysian shares closed with extended losses as funds remained largely sidelined amid concerns over rising U.S. interest rates and the Dow's volatility, dealers said.
The benchmark Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks ended down 7.16 points at 1,226.87, while the all-share EMAS index closed 1.22 points lower at 360.53.

"People are still nervous about the Dow. Its recent volatility is definitely not helping the market," said one institutional dealer at a local firm. "Funds are likely to stay out until after the FOMC meeting."
The market has been bogged by worries that the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will raise interest rates at its next meeting on March 25.
Market volume stood at 381 million shares valued at 2.69 billion ringgit. Decliners outpaced advancers 392 to 221.

Top active stocks included KLI Holdings which fell 15 cents to 5.00 ringgit. The stock had earlier moved up ahead of the launch on Monday of a four-billion ringgit industrial town to be developed by a subsidiary of KLI.
Among blue chips, Telekom Malaysia fell 20 cents to 19.10 ringgit and Edaran Otomobil Nasional was down 25 to 25.00.
